_comment: The only file you edit. Pick the dataset folder under datasets/, enable the policies you want, set compute. Registry facts per policy (training flags, tier, VRAM, licence class) live in trainer/policies/*.yaml and are maintained with the repo, not here. CLI flags of ./finetune.sh override anything below for one run.

secrets._comment: Name of an AWS Secrets Manager secret holding a Hugging Face token. Needed only for gated base weights (pi0 / pi0.5 / pi0_fast PaliGemma tokenizer, GR00T Cosmos-Reason2 processor); read once by the base-weight staging job, never by a training job (training runs with network isolation on).

dataset._comment: source=local reads datasets/<name>/ (the hard requirement: a LeRobot v3.0 dataset folder). source=huggingface downloads hf_repo_id@hf_revision into datasets/<name>/ first (the shipped default is a small public SO-101 pick-and-place set, Apache-2.0). source=s3 points at a dataset already staged in your own bucket. Videos taller than downscale_height are downscaled inside the job; null keeps the source resolution.
dataset.name: svla_so101_pickplace

evaluation._comment: stride 10 keeps the multi-sample VLA evaluation to minutes; the reference band applies to stride-1 evaluations only, so these runs get reference rows, not a verdict

compute._comment: One single-GPU instance per training job; bigger multi-GPU boxes do not speed this trainer up. ml.g6e.4xlarge (L40S 48 GB) is the validated default; ml.g5.4xlarge and ml.g4dn.2xlarge work for ACT at 1/2 and 1/6 of the speed. Quotas default to 0 in new accounts — see README 'Quotas'. spot=true uses managed Spot with checkpoint resume. volume_gb null = derived from the dataset size.

smoke._comment: Before every training job a 200-step job on the same instance proves the image, dataset and flags (< $1). reuse=true skips it when an identical smoke already passed.

policies._comment: Four vision-language-action policies on the public dataset, as recorded in docs/RESULTS.md (2026-09-11). act is left out so the run stays within the g6e.4xlarge quota of 4.

smolvla._comment: Apache-2.0; from-scratch action expert on the staged SmolVLM2 backbone (hub job); batch 16 = the measured step rate

xvla._comment: staged lerobot/xvla-base + BART tokenizer; accept_licence acknowledges the publisher's terms (docs/POLICIES.md)

pi0._comment: staged lerobot/pi0_base + gated google/paligemma-3b-pt-224 tokenizer: needs secrets.hf_token

pi05._comment: as pi0; QUANTILES normalisation, q01/q99 are completed in-job when the dataset lacks them

image._comment: ECR tag the deploy-time CodeBuild image build pushes. Read by cdk/app.py; training jobs pin the image by digest (SSM /<project>/image_uri), never by tag.
